prompt: Please generate an image. Locked painterly style: hand-painted stylized game art, chunky readable shapes, detail painted not modelled, mid-level detail, softer muted colours with gentle saturation, epic and luminous, never grim. The palette's warm gold and cool teal are painted into the surfaces, but the light is flat, even studio light: no strong key light, no cast shadows, no rim light. Use the attached images only as reference as described: the first attachment is always the style reference for palette and brushwork; later attachments are the approved designs to keep. Game-asset reference sheet for 3D modelling, wide landscape 16:9. Plain light neutral grey background, no scene, no sky, no clouds, no floating rock, no ground plane, a soft contact shadow only. Every piece fully isolated with clear space around it, nothing overlapping, nothing touching the edge, arranged in tidy rows, each with a small neat hand-lettered label underneath. VARIANTS sheet: Redraw of the attached reference sheet to the current spec: keep exactly the same design, items, their order and names. The same 2.6 m tall Anchorkin (huge broad grey stone body with teal crystal veins, carved Ledger line on the brow, carved oath-marks on the shoulders, braided sandy-ochre stone-fibre beard, from the second attached image) shown in four outfits, in four columns left to right, each column a full-body front view in a neutral standing pose with arms slightly away from the body, and a smaller full-body back view below it, with clear space between all figures: "1. Starting" (rust-red sleeveless tunic and shorts with a woven gold-pattern hem, thick rope belt, barefoot), "2. Crafter / Gatherer" (cream canvas apron with a gold anvil motif over a brown leather harness, leather bracers, tool belt with hammers, chisels and pouches, brown breeches, leather foot wraps), "3. Light Armour" (brown leather scout armour with straps and pouches, a dagger at the hip, a teal cloak with gold trim and a gold anchor emblem on the back, leather boots), "4. Heavy Armour" (forged iron plate armour with gold trim, gold anchor medallions on the shoulders and chest, teal crystal studs, chain-mail skirt, teal and cream tabard with an anchor emblem). Only the outfit changes between columns. Each label is just the number and name, no description text, no mottos, no side blurbs. Even flat light, no rim light. Keep the exact base design in the second attachment. Show the same base in a neat grid, one part changed per cell, everything else identical, each cell labelled with the variant name. Swappable parts are shown clearly separate from the body where they attach. Title at the top: "Anchorkin: outfits".
